title: mailward accounts
description: The mailboxes mailward processes. Each account picks a vendor (connection + auth defaults come from the code vendor registry) and may override any field. Only the microsoft vendor's auth is implemented today.

id.description: Stable lowercase key (letters/digits/hyphens). Used for the token-cache filename, per-account overrides in config.yaml / rules.yaml, and output section headers.

vendor.description: Provider profile supplying connection + auth defaults. microsoft = Outlook/Hotmail OAuth (implemented). gmail / generic are recognized but their login isn't implemented yet (the account is skipped with a warning).

username.description: The mailbox address to sign in / connect as.

imapHost.description: Override the vendor's default IMAP host (required for the generic vendor).

imapPort.description: Override the vendor's default IMAP port (usually 993).

clientId.description: OAuth client id (microsoft). Defaults to the Mozilla Thunderbird public client; set this if you register your own Entra app.

authority.description: OAuth authority (microsoft). Defaults to the /common tenant.

redirectUri.description: OAuth redirect URI (microsoft). Defaults to https://localhost.

scopes.description: OAuth scopes (microsoft). Defaults to the Outlook IMAP scope.

passwordEnv.description: Name of the .env variable holding this account's password / app-password (password vendors). The secret value stays in .env, never in this file.
